units.text: We'll compare general text analysis with handling sensitive clinical text. For the support example, language, entities, key phrases and sentiment tell you different things. A sentiment score is evidence about the model's interpretation, not proof the customer wants a particular action.

Topic modeling works across a collection rather than just one message. It's closed to new customers; accounts that meet A W S's existing-use criteria can retain access. Check that separately from the other text features.

For an authorized clinical-text workflow, Comprehend Medical can identify medical entities and possible protected health information in supported text. Keep the source and result available only to the appropriate reviewers. Detection doesn't remove the identifiers.

Review the result as appropriate and follow the required data-handling controls. An empty result doesn't prove there is no protected information. A detection feature alone does not make the workflow compliant or the text de-identified.
